description: Final polish pass: ensure all screens integrate cleanly, add smooth page transitions, verify all features work together, add accessibility labels, and commit all changes to the feature branch.
steps: Add screen transition animations in the Stack and Tab navigators (fade for stack, slide for tabs)
Add accessibility labels and roles to all interactive elements (buttons, toggles, cards)
Ensure the SessionContext correctly records sessions when the breathing timer completes a full session
Add a session-complete modal/overlay that shows duration, pattern used, and encouragement message after finishing a session
Verify all imports and cross-references between files are correct
Run npx expo export --platform web to verify final build succeeds
Stage and commit all changes to the revamp/expo-ui-ux branch with a descriptive commit message
acceptance_criteria: All interactive elements have accessibility labels
Sessions are recorded to history when completed
Session complete overlay appears after finishing a session
npx expo export --platform web succeeds with zero errors
All changes are committed to revamp/expo-ui-ux branch
verification: Run npx expo export --platform web and confirm exit code 0
Run git log --oneline -5 to confirm commits are on the feature branch
findings: All changes build successfully with npx expo export --platform web. Used absolutely-positioned View overlay for the session complete modal instead of RN Modal for better web compatibility. GlassCard component was updated to forward accessibility props. The animation: shift option works in expo-router Tabs for tab transition effects.
